source_name: Origo.hu — Gazdaság rovat
why_relevant: High-reach portal that carries bank quarterly-result stories, frequently close to the bank's own press release wording — useful as a press-release mirror when the bank's IR page is unstable. Editorial independence is contested, so use for factual figure/timestamp capture only, not interpretation.

source_name: MTI OS – Országos Sajtószolgálat (os.mti.hu)
why_relevant: Canonical paid corporate-announcement wire in Hungary; banks, PSPs and fintechs push sajtóközlemény here verbatim, often earlier and richer in partnership/vendor detail than IR filings. Separately indexable and has a detailed search (reszletes_kereses) usable as a systematic discovery seed for actors and product launches.

source_name: MTI – Nemzeti Hírügynökség / nemzeti közleménytár
why_relevant: Parent news agency of OS; the 'nemzeti közleménytár' carries dated official communiqués including financial-sector items and is a route to identifying which corporate releases entered the national wire.

source_name: Helló Sajtó! – business press release distribution portal
why_relevant: Free-to-read commercial PR wire used by Hungarian banks (a dedicated K&H Bank Zrt. author page exists) and by the PR agencies serving them (Goodwill Communications, Noguchi, FLOW PR). Author/agency taxonomy makes it an excellent snowball surface for both issuers and their agencies.

source_name: OTP Bank – Közlemények (regulated disclosures, IR)
why_relevant: Year-partitioned regulated announcement archive; the disciplined counterpart to the free-form newsroom, useful to separate legally mandated disclosures from PR-only signals.

source_name: MBH Bank – Sajtószoba
why_relevant: Second-largest HU banking group (MKB + Takarékbank + Budapest Bank merger); its press room bundles press releases with annual reports and economic analyses, so post-merger core-banking and branch/ATM integration signals surface here first.

source_name: Erste Bank Hungary – Sajtó és médiakapcsolat / Sajtóközlemények
why_relevant: Dedicated press-release listing for Erste Hungary and its subsidiaries, plus a media-contact page identifying the spokespeople — useful both as content and as an actor-map input.

source_name: K&H Bank és Biztosító – Közlemények
why_relevant: KBC-owned universal bank+insurer; its group announcements page covers both banking and insurance product/tech launches. K&H also distributes via Helló Sajtó!, so the two channels can be diffed to see what was pushed to the wire.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. (HU) – Sajtószoba / Sajtóközlemények
why_relevant: Publishes not only PR but operational notices such as 'rendszerfejlesztés' (system development/maintenance windows), which are a direct weak signal of core-banking and channel migration work.

source_name: CIB Bank – Sajtószoba, sajtóközlemények, hivatalos közzétételek
why_relevant: Intesa Sanpaolo-owned bank; press room explicitly combines PR with 'hivatalos közzétételek' (official publications), giving both marketing and compliance-grade signals in one place. Site serves parallel /hu/ and /en/ paths.

source_name: GIRO Zrt. – corporate site / news
why_relevant: Operator of the InterGIRO2 / instant payment clearing infrastructure, now majority-owned by MNB. Its own communications (and reactive statements during outages) are the earliest formal word on national payment-infrastructure change — e.g. the KVR central fraud-filtering system built with Magyar Telekom.

source_name: FinTechZone – GIRO Zrt. and vendor tag pages
why_relevant: Hungarian fintech trade outlet that republishes and contextualises bank/PSP press releases; its tag taxonomy per company acts as a de facto per-actor press archive when the company's own newsroom has no archive or RSS.

source_name: Origo / HVG company tag pages (cimke) for financial actors
why_relevant: General-press per-company tag feeds capture press-release-derived coverage and, importantly, corporate reactive statements during incidents (outages, fraud) that never reach the corporate newsroom. Useful redundancy layer against newsrooms that delete old items.

source_name: Goodwill Communications – PR agency press feed
why_relevant: Agency-level feeds reveal which vendor/bank accounts an agency handles, exposing client relationships and letting you monitor a whole portfolio of financial clients from one page — a classic 'reveals-indirectly' source.

source_name: Budapesti Értéktőzsde (BÉT) – Sajtószoba / issuer announcements
why_relevant: Exchange press room plus the statutory publication venue where OTP and other listed issuers must disclose alongside their own sites, per Act CXX of 2001 — the regulated floor against which newsroom-only claims can be checked.

source_name: MNB – Sajtószoba / Pressroom (bilingual)
why_relevant: Central bank press releases frequently name specific banks and PSPs (supervisory measures, AML orders, payment-scheme mandates), so they both corroborate and contradict corporate newsroom framing. Year-partitioned archive with a parallel English pressroom.

source_name: GVH – Sajtószoba archive (competition authority)
why_relevant: Competition-authority press releases name bank and payment entities in merger and conduct cases; the archive reaches back two decades, giving historical depth that corporate newsrooms lack.

source_name: NKFIH online-sajtó – R&D announcements naming banks
why_relevant: State R&D agency press items disclose bank technology programmes in unusual detail — e.g. OTP Bank's AI hardware-capacity build-out and the closure of a four-year R&D project — the kind of vendor/infrastructure signal that corporate PR usually omits.

source_name: PwC Hungary – Sajtószoba (professional-services newsroom)
why_relevant: Advisory-firm press releases publish survey-backed sector figures (e.g. the 'Digitális fordulat a hazai pénzforgalomban' digital-payments picture) that banks then cite; a reliable, dated, free source of quantified sector claims released through PR channels.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Hungary – press/media section (via Bankszövetség member registry)
why_relevant: Top-5 HU bank whose press room was not surfaced directly by search; URL inferred from the site's standard /hu/rolunk/ information architecture and must be confirmed. Included as a must-cover actor rather than a verified path.

source_name: Gránit Bank – press/news channel (actor placeholder)
why_relevant: Fast-growing digital-first HU bank, an early adopter in the Apple Pay / digital-wallet cohort, so a high-yield source of product-launch weak signals — but no press-room path was observed in this pass.

source_name: OTP Group Investor Relations - Credit ratings page (rating agency reports republished by issuer)
why_relevant: OTP republishes the full PDF text of Moody's, S&P and Scope rating actions (e.g. 251030_Rating_Action.pdf, 240327_Rating_action_OTP.pdf) on its own IR domain, outside the agencies' paywalls/registration walls. This is the single most reliable free channel for agency-verified balance-sheet and outlook commentary on the largest Hungarian bank.

source_name: Scope Ratings - OTP Bank Nyrt. issuer rating-news feed
source_subtype: credit rating agency issuer page / rating action releases
why_relevant: Scope is the EU-registered agency that publishes full rating action press releases openly (no subscription), including the rating rationale and peer comparison for OTP. Provides an independent second opinion where Moody's/S&P full reports are gated.

source_name: Scope Ratings - MFB Magyar Fejlesztési Bank rating actions
why_relevant: MFB is a state development bank with thin English disclosure; the Scope release restates the statutory state guarantee, funding structure and sovereign linkage - disclosure-grade facts available nowhere else in English.

source_name: MBH Bank - Ratings page (Moody's) on bond/investor site
why_relevant: MBH (Hungary's #2 bank, product of the MKB/Takarék/Budapest Bank merger) is unlisted for equity purposes and publishes little in English; its bond-investor ratings page carries the Moody's deposit/BCA/subordinated rating stack and the accompanying credit opinion references.

source_name: MBH Bank - Rendkívüli közzétételek (extraordinary disclosures, HU)
why_relevant: Rating changes are legally disclosable events; MBH files the Hungarian-language announcement here often before/instead of any English release. Local-language primary channel for agency actions on the #2 bank.

source_name: Moody's Ratings - issuer pages for Hungarian banks (OTP, OTP Mortgage Bank, MBH, Erste Bank Hungary, K&H, Budapest Bank legacy)
why_relevant: Primary originator of the rating actions and annual Credit Opinions that restate capital, asset quality and funding for banks with no other English disclosure. Even the free headline/press-release layer gives dated, attributable rating stack changes.

source_name: S&P Global Ratings - regulatory disclosure article archive (free 'Research Update' HTML/PDF)
why_relevant: S&P publishes full Research Updates for EU-regulated disclosure purposes on the /ratings/en/regulatory/article/ path - these are free-to-read and contain the full analytical rationale for OTP Bank, OTP Mortgage Bank and the Hungarian sovereign that anchors bank ratings.
